payout_quote: Receive up to $100* your first donation. Receive up to $800* your first month as a new donor. *Varies by location and is subject to change
steps: Find a CSL Plasma center near you on the official site and sign up for new-donor information.
Book and attend your first visit: complete the medical history screening and physical exam.
Complete your first plasma donation (CSL says the first donation takes 2 to 2.5 hours) and receive compensation on the CSL prepaid card.
Continue donating through your first month (up to twice a week) to accrue toward the new-donor total.
catches: Amounts are 'up to' ceilings that vary by location and are subject to change — many centers pay less than the advertised maximum.
You must pass a medical history screening and physical exam; not everyone qualifies to donate.
Each donation visit takes roughly 90-150 minutes of your time; you must donate repeatedly (twice weekly for new-donor offers) to earn the headline totals.
First donation takes 2 to 2.5 hours; later donations take about 90 minutes — per CSL's own site.
Reaching the first-month total requires donating repeatedly (up to twice a week) for a month, not a single visit.
Must be 18+, weigh at least 110 lbs, be in good health, show valid ID with a permanent address, and have no tattoos/piercings in the last 4 months (per CSL's qualify page).
biggest_catch: The advertised amounts are 'up to' ceilings that vary by location — your center may pay materially less — and you must pass medical screening; not everyone qualifies.
eligibility: 18+, at least 110 lbs, in good health, valid ID and permanent address, no tattoos or piercings in the last 4 months, and must pass the medical history screening and physical exam. Compensation varies by location.
timing: Compensation is loaded onto a CSL prepaid debit card after each donation, usable right away; the new-donor total accrues across donations in your first month.
